name: omavcam
author: Sphiment
description: Use an Android phone as a virtual webcam, via scrcpy and v4l2loopback.

barWidget.description: Stream an Android phone's camera or screen into a virtual webcam.

schema.label: Camera
schema.description: Which camera to use when no explicit camera id is set.

schema.label: Camera id
schema.description: Explicit camera id. Overrides the camera setting when set.

schema.label: Resolution
schema.description: Must be a resolution the camera offers; leave empty for its default.

schema.label: Frame rate
schema.description: Capture frame rate. Leave empty for the camera's default.

schema.label: Preview shows
schema.description: loopback shows the virtual camera itself; scrcpy shows scrcpy's own window, which can also control the phone.

schema.label: Snap the preview to edges
schema.description: Dragging the preview near a corner, an edge, or the centre parks it there. Drop it anywhere else and it stays where you put it.

schema.label: Phone serial
schema.description: Which phone to use when more than one is connected.

schema.label: Hide when no phone is connected
